fusions.name: Felling Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away and brings the edge down, which deals 28 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Hock Cutter
fusions.desc: A low sweep at the legs that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Falling Stride
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lagging Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
